flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/ManageTemplate/form/EditTemplateForm.tsx (email edit form: Subject + rich editor, test-send block commented out), App.tsx (route edit-template/email), hooks/useAPITemplate.tsx, utils/mapping/ManageTemplate/ManageTemplateMap.ts. ocmsadminapi OcmsTemplateStoreController (create/list/patch/render only), workflows/furnish/manualreview/controllers/ManualReviewController (Furnish send-email). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no template test send
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. Editing email text exists and works (Subject + rich editor, subject and body are merged with the ---SUBJECT--- / ---BODY--- markers, saved through templatestorepatch). Test send does not exist, same as OCMS36.2: there is no email address field or test send button, the test block in EditTemplateForm.tsx is commented out, and the template controller has no send endpoint. The send-email endpoint in the Furnish module exists but is for replies to Furnish applicants (tied to txnNo/noticeNo), not a template test send. The prod property is email.enableSmtp=false (application-prod.properties:80); the real server value cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket concerns email test send.
recommendation: Claim only the email text editing part. The email address field and test send are not built; ask URA to confirm whether they will be built or removed from scope

steps.step: Officer selects an email template and opens the edit screen
steps.detail: From the Email tab, the View button navigates to /enotification/edit-template/email with the row data (TemplateList.tsx:108-116; App.tsx:274-278) and EditTemplateForm type EMAIL shows Template Name, Remarks, Subject and content.

steps.step: Officer edits the email subject and body
steps.detail: The subject is edited through TextInput and the content through EditorInput with a text-format toolbar (EditTemplateForm.tsx:156-202). On open the template is split into subject and body (ManageTemplateMap.ts:46-62); on save they are merged again with ---SUBJECT--- / ---BODY--- (ManageTemplateMap.ts:64-69,222-227) and POSTed to templatestorepatch (useAPITemplate.tsx:104-110).

steps.step: Officer enters an email address for the test in a field
steps.detail: The email edit form only contains Template Name, dates (readonly), Remarks, Subject and the content editor (EditTemplateForm.tsx:108-202). There is no recipient email address input; the block that holds the preview/test button is commented out (EditTemplateForm.tsx:49-71). Same fact as OCMS36.2 for SMS.

steps.step: The edited email arrives as a test message
steps.detail: The template controller only has create, list, patch and render (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:28-33,176-204); render only fills notice placeholders and does not send. The Furnish /manual-review/send-email endpoint (ManualReviewController.java:301-302) is not called from the template screen, so it is not a test send. The prod property is email.enableSmtp=false (application-prod.properties:80); the server value and SMTP delivery cannot verify from repo. Same fact as OCMS36.2.
